name: mstack-write-issue
description: Well-formed tracker issues from what the session already knows. It searches open and closed issues before it drafts, and turns a match into a comment with only the new evidence. It writes in the repository's own issue template, or in a fixed outline for a bug, a feature or a follow-up, and ends every issue with a line that says when it is done. A bug that does not happen every time gets its counts and conditions, never steps that pretend to reproduce it. Credentials, private hosts, names and home paths are replaced before anything is shown. It posts only after you approve the exact text in a later message, with gh on GitHub, through a connected tool on another tracker, or as a draft to paste. The delivery workflows offer it for deferred follow-ups. One skill for Claude Code and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Issue drafts with a duplicate check, the repository's template and no private data.
interface.longDescription: Turns a finding into one tracker issue a maintainer can act on. It checks open and closed issues first, uses the repository's own template, gives counts for a bug that does not happen every time, ends with a line that says when the issue is done, and replaces credentials, private hosts, names and home paths. It shows the exact text and posts only after you approve it in a later message. Other mstack skills call it to draft issues for follow-ups they deferred.
